土壤的主要形成因素与土壤剖面观察: Soil-Forming Factors and Soil Profile Observation
土壤 = 矿物质 + 有机质 + 水分 + 空气: Soil = minerals + organic matter + water + air
东北的土又黑又肥，南方的土为什么相对贫瘠？: Soil in Northeast China is black and fertile. Why is soil in the south relatively poor?
成土母质：岩石风化产物，定矿物质、养分与质地: Parent material: weathered rock, sets the minerals, nutrients and texture
生物：最基本最活跃，提供有机质，没生物就没土壤: Organisms: the most basic and most active factor; they supply organic matter, and without them there's no soil
气候：水热定风化与淋溶快慢、黏粒多少、有机质积累: Climate: heat and moisture set the pace of weathering and leaching, the clay content and organic matter build-up
地貌：山顶到低平洼地，颗粒由粗到细: Landform: from hilltop to low-lying land, particles go from coarse to fine
时间：越久越厚越分化，20 cm 要 100—1000 年: Time: the longer, the thicker and more differentiated; 20 cm takes 100–1000 years
人类活动：耕作成三层；种养结合保住肥力: Human activity: farming creates three layers; combining cropping with soil care keeps it fertile
柱顶的草木与枯枝落叶：有机质从这里来: Plants and fallen leaves on top of the column: this is where organic matter comes from
有机层 → 腐殖质层 → 淋溶层 → 淀积层 → 母质层: Organic layer → humus layer → eluvial layer → illuvial layer → parent material layer
底部的母岩层：母质从这里风化而来: The bedrock layer at the bottom: parent material weathers from here
这块土壤标本自上而下能分出几层？: How many layers can you make out in this soil sample from top to bottom?
拖动视角绕柱子看一圈：上表面、侧面、各层界线: Drag the view around the column: top surface, sides, and the boundaries between layers
六层自上而下：有机层 1.6、腐殖质层 5.9、淋溶层 7.0、淀积层 5.6、: Six layers from top to bottom: organic layer 1.6, humus layer 5.9, eluvial layer 7.0, illuvial layer 5.6, parent material layer 32.1, bedrock layer 47.8 cm; organic matter 1.46 → 0.80 → 0.44 → 0.18 → 0.06 → 0 %
有机层 → 腐殖质层 → 淋溶层 → 淀积层 → 母质层 → 母岩层: Organic → humus → eluvial → illuvial → parent material → bedrock
森林土壤剖面（教材图 5.17）· 层序照教材，厚度为课件示意: Forest soil profile (textbook Fig. 5.17) · layer order per textbook, thicknesses illustrative
森林土壤最复杂: Forest soils are the most complex
土壤由矿物质、有机质、水分和空气四种物质组成；野外观察看颜色、质地、剖面构造（教: Soil consists of four things: minerals, organic matter, water and air; in the field, look at color, texture and profile structure (textbook p.88).
剖面是从地面垂直向下的纵剖面，土层大致呈水平展布，是物质转化、迁移、积累的结果。: A profile is a vertical section from the surface downward; the layers are roughly horizontal and result from substances being transformed, moved and accumulated.
森林土壤剖面最复杂，六层自上而下：有机层 → 腐殖质层 → 淋溶层 → 淀积层: Forest soil profiles are the most complex, with six layers from top to bottom: organic → humus → eluvial → illuvial → parent material → bedrock; organic matter decreases with depth.
去掉这一步：学生会把剖面说成「表土 / 心土 / 底土」三层，也分不清淋溶层失、: Skip this step and students describe the profile as three layers, "topsoil / subsoil / substratum", and can't tell that the eluvial layer loses material while the illuvial layer gains it.
考点：森林土壤剖面自上而下的六层名称与顺序；哪一层颜色最浅（淋溶层）、哪一层黏重: Exam point: names and order of the six forest soil layers from top to bottom; which layer is palest (eluvial) and which is heavy and compact (illuvial).
土壤剖面是从地面垂直向下的纵剖面，由形态特征各异、大致水平展布的土层构成；自然土: A soil profile is a vertical section from the surface downward, made of roughly horizontal layers with different features; among natural soils, forest soil profiles are the most complex, from top to bottom: organic, humus, eluvial, illuvial, parent material and bedrock layers.
母质不同，土壤的质地会怎样变？: How does soil texture change with different parent material?
把「成土母质」从壤质拖到黏质，看颗粒与质地: Drag "Parent material" from loamy to clayey and watch the particles and texture
颗粒指数 0.56 → 0.86；质地 壤土 → 黏土；黏粒 33.3 → 42: Particle index 0.56 → 0.86; texture loam → clay; clay content 33.3 → 42.3 %; at the sandy end: particle index 0.26, gravelly soil, clay 24.3 %
母质 → 矿物质成分 · 养分状况 · 质地: Parent material → mineral composition · nutrients · texture
成土母质是土壤发育的物质基础（教材 p.91）: Parent material is the material basis of soil development (textbook p.91)
紫色土 = 母质的证据: Purple soil = evidence of parent material
成土母质是岩石的风化产物，是土壤发育的物质基础。: Parent material is the weathering product of rock and the material basis of soil development.
它决定土壤矿物质的成分和养分状况，影响土壤的质地：砂质母质 → 砾质土 / 砂土: It sets the soil's mineral composition and nutrients and affects its texture: sandy parent material → gravelly soil / sand, clayey parent material → clay.
四川盆地的岩石是紫色的，土壤也呈紫色——这条现象的主导因素就是成土母质。: Rocks in the Sichuan Basin are purple and so is the soil; the dominant factor behind this is parent material.
去掉这一步：学生会以为质地只由「种什么」决定，也解释不了紫色土。: Skip this step and students think texture depends only on "what's grown", and can't explain purple soil.
考点：紫色土的主导成土因素是成土母质；母质主要影响质地与矿物质、养分，不直接决定: Exam point: the dominant factor for purple soil is parent material; parent material mainly affects texture, minerals and nutrients, not directly the amount of organic matter.
成土母质是岩石的风化产物，是土壤发育的物质基础；它决定土壤矿物质的成分和养分状况: Parent material is the weathering product of rock and the material basis of soil development; it sets the mineral composition and nutrients of soil and affects its texture.
把植被去掉，这块土还会是土壤吗？: Take away the vegetation. Would this still be soil?
把「植被覆盖率」从 60 % 拖到 100 %，再把生物放到 0 % 看会发生什: Drag "Vegetation cover" from 60 % to 100 %, then set organisms to 0 % to see what happens
表层有机质 1.46 → 2.44 %；有机层 1.6 → 2.6 cm、腐殖质: Surface organic matter 1.46 → 2.44 %; organic layer 1.6 → 2.6 cm, humus layer 5.9 → 9.8 cm; at 0 % organisms both the organic and humus layers are 0, organic matter 0 %, and only 3 horizons remain
生物是最基本也是最活跃的成土因素（教材 p.91）: Organisms are the most basic and most active soil-forming factor (textbook p.91)
生物是影响土壤发育最基本也是最活跃的因素——没有生物的作用，就不可能形成土壤。: Organisms are the most basic and most active factor in soil development: without organisms, soil cannot form.
生物残体为土壤提供有机质，有机质在微生物作用下转化为腐殖质。: Organic remains supply soil with organic matter, which microbes turn into humus.
生物循环把氮、磷、钾等营养元素搬到土壤表层富集：生物 0 % 时有机层与腐殖质层: Biological cycling moves nutrients such as nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium to the surface: at 0 % organisms the organic and humus layers vanish and organic matter is 0.
去掉这一步：学生把生物只当成「施肥」，不知道它是成土的前提。: Skip this step and students see organisms only as "fertilizer", not as a precondition for soil.
考点：为什么说「没有生物的作用就不可能形成土壤」；生物 0 % 时剖面的哪两层消: Exam point: why "without organisms, soil cannot form"; which two layers disappear at 0 % organisms (organic and humus layers).
生物是影响土壤发育最基本也是最活跃的因素；生物残体提供有机质、微生物把有机质变成: Organisms are the most basic and most active factor in soil development; organic remains supply organic matter, microbes turn it into humus, and biological cycling concentrates nutrients at the soil surface.
同样的母质，湿热和干冷会养出一样的土吗？: With the same parent material, do hot-wet and cold-dry climates grow the same soil?
年降水先放到 2000 mm，再把年均温从 15 ℃ 拖到 25 ℃: Set annual precipitation to 2000 mm first, then drag the mean annual temperature from 15 °C to 25 °C
成土速率 1.12 → 2.00 mm/a；形成 20 cm 只要 177.8: Formation rate 1.12 → 2.00 mm/a; forming 20 cm takes only 177.8 → 100.0 a; leaching moderate → strong; clay 43.3 → 50.8 %; surface organic matter 3.37 → 1.35 %; eluvial layer 17.6 → 21.6 cm, illuvial layer 14.4 → 18.0 cm
湿热成土快、黏粒多、有机质分解快（教材 p.91）: Hot-wet: fast formation, more clay, faster organic matter breakdown (textbook p.91)
岩石风化的强度和速度与温度、降水量呈正相关，所以湿热地区的土壤形成速度比干冷地区: The intensity and speed of rock weathering correlate positively with temperature and precipitation, so soil forms much faster in hot-wet regions than in cold-dry ones.
湿热地区化学风化与淋溶作用强，土壤黏粒比重高；冷湿环境有利于有机质积累，干旱、高: In hot-wet regions chemical weathering and leaching are strong and clay content is high; cold-wet conditions favor organic matter build-up, while dry, hot regions accumulate little.
注意：雨量和气温只改黏粒占比，不改质地名称——质地由母质与地貌定。: Note: rainfall and temperature change only the clay share, not the texture name; texture is set by parent material and landform.
去掉这一步：学生会得出「越热越肥」的反结论。: Skip this step and students reach the opposite conclusion, "the hotter, the more fertile".
考点：为什么湿热地区土壤黏粒多、土层厚得快，但有机质反而少；冷湿与干旱高温对有机: Exam point: why soils in hot-wet regions are clayey and thicken fast but have less organic matter; how cold-wet and dry-hot conditions differ in organic matter build-up.
水热条件决定风化和淋溶的快慢：湿热地区成土快、黏粒多、淋溶强、有机质分解快；冷湿: Heat and moisture set the pace of weathering and leaching: hot-wet regions form soil fast, with more clay, strong leaching and fast organic matter breakdown; cold-wet conditions favor organic matter build-up, dry-hot regions accumulate little.
山顶和山前平原的土，颗粒一样粗吗？: Are the soil particles on a hilltop as coarse as those on the plain at the foot of the hill?
把「地貌部位」从山顶一路拖到低平洼地: Drag "Landform position" from hilltop all the way to low-lying land
颗粒指数 0.32 → 0.44 → 0.56 → 0.68；质地依次为 砾质土: Particle index 0.32 → 0.44 → 0.56 → 0.68; texture gravelly soil → sand → loam → clay; clay 26.1 → 29.7 → 33.3 → 36.9 %
从山顶到低平洼地，母质颗粒由粗到细（教材 p.91）: From hilltop to low-lying land, parent material particles go from coarse to fine (textbook p.91)
山顶粗 → 洼地细: Coarse on top → fine in hollows
地貌通过水热条件与母质颗粒的分选影响土壤发育。: Landform affects soil development through heat and moisture and by sorting parent material particles.
从山顶到低平洼地，成土母质的颗粒存在由粗到细的变化规律：砾质土 → 砂土 → 壤: From hilltop to low-lying land, parent material particles change from coarse to fine: gravelly soil → sand → loam → clay.
壤土的砂粒、粉粒、黏粒比例适中，通气透水又蓄水保肥，是农业生产理想的土壤质地。: Loam has a balanced mix of sand, silt and clay, letting air and water through while holding water and nutrients: the ideal texture for farming.
去掉这一步：学生会把「山上的土」当成更肥的土。: Skip this step and students assume "soil up the hill" is more fertile.
考点：山顶土壤颗粒较粗、山前平原较细的原因；四类质地由粗到细的顺序。: Exam point: why hilltop soils are coarser and piedmont plain soils finer; the four textures in order from coarse to fine.
从山顶到低平洼地，成土母质的颗粒由粗到细，依次分布着砾质土、砂土、壤土和黏土；所: From hilltop to low-lying land, parent material particles go from coarse to fine, with gravelly soil, sand, loam and clay in turn; so hilltop soils are coarser and piedmont plains finer.
挖下去 20 cm 的土，要多久才能长出来？: How long does it take for 20 cm of soil to form?
把「成土时间」从 1000 年拖到 2000 年，再往回拖到 0 看差别: Drag "Formation time" from 1000 to 2000 years, then back to 0 to see the difference
土层总厚 52.2 → 90.0 cm；母岩层 47.8 → 10.0 cm；腐: Total soil depth 52.2 → 90.0 cm; bedrock layer 47.8 → 10.0 cm; humus layer 5.9 → 10.1 cm; 0 layers at 0 years, 4 layers at 200 years; forming 20 cm of arable soil takes 383.1 a (textbook range 100–1000 years)
时间越长 → 土层越厚 · 分化越明显: Longer time → thicker soil · clearer layers
20 cm 耕地土壤要 100—1 000 年（教材 p.92）: 20 cm of arable soil takes 100–1,000 years (textbook p.92)
土壤发育的时间越长，土壤层越厚，土层分化越明显。: The longer soil develops, the thicker it gets and the more clearly its layers differentiate.
在自然状态下，形成 20 cm 厚可供耕作的土壤，一般需要 100—1 000: Under natural conditions, forming 20 cm of arable soil generally takes 100–1,000 years.
所以柱子里的每一厘米土层都是「攒」出来的：母岩层被风化掉一层，土层就厚一层。: So every centimeter in the column was "saved up": each layer of bedrock weathered away adds a layer of soil.
去掉这一步：学生会以为土是「本来就有的」，也就不知道保护表土的意义。: Skip this step and students think soil "was always there" and don't see why topsoil needs protecting.
考点：时间对土层厚度与分层明显程度的作用；形成 20 cm 可供耕作土壤一般需要: Exam point: how time affects soil thickness and how clear the layers are; the usual number of years to form 20 cm of arable soil.
土壤发育的时间越长，土壤层越厚、土层分化越明显；自然状态下形成 20 cm 厚可: The longer soil develops, the thicker it gets and the more clearly its layers differentiate; under natural conditions 20 cm of arable soil generally takes 100–1,000 years to form.
一块地被长期耕种，剖面会变成什么样？: What does the profile look like after a plot has been farmed for a long time?
把「人类活动」拨到种养结合，中间先看「只用不养」: Switch "Human activity" to cropping with soil care, but first look at "use without care"
层序换成 耕作层 20.9 / 犁底层 8.0 / 自然土层 23.3 cm；表: The layers change to plow layer 20.9 / plow pan 8.0 / natural soil 23.3 cm; surface organic matter 1.46 → (use without care) 1.10 → (cropping with soil care) 1.61 %
耕作层 · 犁底层 · 自然土层: Plow layer · plow pan · natural soil layer
耕作土壤剖面（教材图 5.18）· 种养结合保住肥力: Cultivated soil profile (textbook Fig. 5.18) · cropping with soil care keeps it fertile
耕层疏松 · 犁底紧实: Loose plow layer · compact plow pan
只用不养 → 有机质降: Use without care → organic matter falls
自然土壤经过长期耕作培育就变成耕作土壤，剖面分耕作层、犁底层和自然土层。: Natural soil becomes cultivated soil after long farming, with a profile of plow layer, plow pan and natural soil layer.
耕作层又称表土层或熟土层：土质疏松、有机质比例高、颜色较暗；犁底层又称亚表土层：: The plow layer, also called topsoil or mature soil, is loose, high in organic matter and darker; the plow pan, also called the sub-topsoil, is compact and paler and holds nutrients and water; the natural soil layer is unimproved and poor for crops.
只用不养，表层有机质降到 1.10 %；种养结合（休耕、种植绿肥、轮作、广施农家: Use without care drops surface organic matter to 1.10 %; cropping with soil care (fallowing, green manure, crop rotation, plenty of farmyard manure) brings it back to 1.61 %.
去掉这一步：学生只会「用地」不会「养地」。: Skip this step and students only know how to "use" land, not how to "care for" it.
考点：耕作土壤剖面的三层名称与各自特点；种养结合（休耕、绿肥、轮作、农家肥）为什: Exam point: the names and features of the three layers of a cultivated soil profile; why cropping with soil care (fallowing, green manure, rotation, farmyard manure) keeps soil fertile.
自然土壤经长期耕作变成耕作土壤，剖面分耕作层、犁底层、自然土层；种养结合（休耕、: Natural soil becomes cultivated soil after long farming, with a profile of plow layer, plow pan and natural soil layer; cropping with soil care (fallowing, green manure, rotation, plenty of farmyard manure) keeps soil able to supply high fertility over time.
考核：把这块地育成一块肥沃的耕地: Assessment: turn this plot into fertile farmland
调到 质地壤土 + 表层有机质 ≥ 3 % + 种养结合，并保持 15 s: Set texture to loam + surface organic matter ≥ 3 % + cropping with soil care, and hold for 15 s
达标解：生物 100 %、年均温 10 ℃、年降水 1200 mm、壤质母质、山: A passing solution: organisms 100 %, mean annual temperature 10 °C, annual precipitation 1200 mm, loamy parent material, foothill, 1000 a, cropping with soil care → loam texture, surface organic matter 5.01 %, plow layer 20.2 cm
壤土 + 有机质 ≥ 3 % + 种养结合: Loam + organic matter ≥ 3 % + cropping with soil care
目标条：三件事同时成立才变绿: Goal bar: turns green only when all three hold at once
有机质不是越热越多: Hotter doesn't mean more organic matter
有机质要「有来源」：生物量得够，生物 0 % 时有机层直接消失。: Organic matter needs a "source": there must be enough biomass, and at 0 % organisms the organic layer simply disappears.
还要「存得住」：冷湿比湿热更容易积累——温度高、雨多时有机质反而被分解掉。: It also has to "be kept": cold-wet conditions accumulate it more easily than hot-wet ones, where heat and rain break it down instead.
质地看母质与地貌：壤质母质 + 山麓刚好是壤土；雨量只改黏粒占比，改不了质地名称: Texture depends on parent material and landform: loamy parent material + foothill gives exactly loam; rainfall only changes the clay share, not the texture name.
去掉这一步：学生会把「多施肥」当成唯一办法，忽略水热与质地。: Skip this step and students treat "more fertilizer" as the only answer, ignoring heat, moisture and texture.
考点：影响土壤肥力的因素不只一个——生物量、水热条件、质地与耕作方式都要合适。: Exam point: soil fertility depends on more than one factor; biomass, heat and moisture, texture and farming practices all need to be right.
肥沃的耕地要同时满足：质地壤土（母质与地貌合适）、表层有机质 ≥ 3 %（生物量: Fertile farmland needs all of these at once: loam texture (suitable parent material and landform), surface organic matter ≥ 3 % (enough biomass + good conditions for build-up), and sticking with cropping plus soil care.

淋溶：矿物质随水下渗: Leaching: minerals carried down with water
